item.title: Vaxcyte Announces Pricing of $550 Million Public Offering
item.description: SAN CARLOS, Calif., Jan. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vaxcyte, Inc. (NASDAQ:PCVX), a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company, announced today the pricing of an underwritten public offering of common stock. Vaxcyte is selling 11,000,000 shares of common stock in the offering at a public offering price of $50.00 per share.
